    dp = [0] * (n+1)
    dp[n] = 1

            # Check if the current item fits in the box
            if j >= volumes[i]:
                # Update the dp array with the maximum of the current value and the current item plus the previous item

    # Return the minimum remaining space
    return V - dp[0]
